adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb, the `before_validation` callback unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice. If `host` is nil (e.g., `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` missing in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host), this will raise `NoMethodError` before validations run. There is no presence check/guard in the callback, so this can produce a 500 instead of a validation error.
